source.name: RomaPress - Roma to earn €3 million per season from Wizz Air partnership
source.quote: Financially, the deal should generate revenue for Roma in excess of €3 million per year.

note: Reported 'in excess of €3 million per year' (citing Il Tempo), so upTo is false but the figure is a floor; recorded as approximately €3m per year. Sleeve sponsorship debuted 15 December 2025 per the club's announcement.
